title: Pre-registered broad-PIT opening 10/15-minute price-volume family
pre_performance_amendment: The first execution stopped before any return was computed because the broad 09:35 cache contains no SPY row and the empty exact-clock frame exposed a date dtype mismatch. The current market input was replaced with the contemporaneous PIT top500 median first-five return, while lagged beta remains estimated against prior-session SPY returns. The exact date is normalized after extraction and the sample start is aligned to the first available 09:35 session, 2018-04-27. A second execution timed out before output while sequentially reading and hashing 16,995 monthly source files. Extraction now reads 16 files concurrently and records path, size, and selected-row count; provenance retains the raw fetch-manifest hash and the complete source inventory rather than re-reading every parquet for an individual hash. Hypothesis count, thresholds, execution clocks, costs, and gates are unchanged.
post_result_causality_correction: The first completed performance run is invalid and preserved under the INVALID_EXIT_AVAILABILITY_LOOKAHEAD prefix. Audit found that it required the future scheduled exit bar to exist before ranking/refill. The corrected engine ranks and refills using only signal fields plus the exact 09:40 entry available at execution time. A missing scheduled exit is executed at the first available five-minute bar open through 10:30 under a fixed causal fallback; future exit availability never changes selected membership. No signal, threshold, ranking score, gate, or candidate count was changed.
causal_halt_amendment: The first corrected execution stopped before simulation when TWTR on 2021-11-29 remained halted past the initially specified 10:30 fallback limit and resumed at 10:55. The fixed exit order now remains live until the first exact five-minute bar open through 16:00. If no same-session print exists, the engine hard-fails and no result is accepted. The halted name remains selected; no replacement or future-availability filter is allowed.
objective: Test whether opening price displacement plus lagged volume, beta, and SIC context predicts the next 10 or 15 minutes without a regime filter.
hypothesis_families: Residual opening shock reversal after removing lagged-beta SPY first-five and current SIC median movement.
Residual opening shock continuation after the same market and SIC residualization.
Large overnight gap rejected by the completed first-five-minute bar, followed in the first-five direction.
Large overnight gap confirmed by the completed first-five-minute bar, followed in the common direction.

causal_clock.signal_information_cutoff: 09:35 America/New_York after the 09:30 bar has closed.
causal_clock.entry: Exact open of the 09:40 five-minute bar, providing one full five-minute latency buffer.
exits: Exact open of the 09:50 bar for a 10-minute hold.
Exact open of the 09:55 bar for a 15-minute hold.
causal_clock.forbidden: No 09:35 bar field, post-entry field, intrabar stop, take-profit, daily regime, or future label may enter selection.

data_contract.touched_validation: 2023-01-03 through 2024-12-31; opened only for the single development winner after all gates pass.
data_contract.universe: Quarterly PIT market-cap top500 intersected with the daily PIT eligible universe and ADV20 >= $10m.
features_known_by_0935: 09:30 volume divided by its ticker-specific prior-20-session mean
09:30 bar high-low range and close location
60-session beta estimated from prev_dayret and SPY prev_dayret, therefore ending no later than the prior session
current PIT top500 median first-five return, multiplied by lagged SPY beta as the market component
current PIT SIC median market-residual first-five return
data_contract.event_thresholds: rvol >= 1.5, 09:30 range/open >= 0.4%, direction-adjusted close location >= 0.25; residual shock >= 0.5%, or abs gap >= 1.5% plus abs first-five >= 0.3%.
data_contract.selection: Rank by absolute directional signal times sqrt(capped rvol) times sqrt(capped range shock); require exactly five longs and five shorts after exact-price filtering; maximum two names per SIC per side.
data_contract.portfolio: Dollar neutral, 0.5x long plus 0.5x short, 10% NAV per name, daily flat at the fixed exit.
data_contract.execution: 4 bps per traded dollar per side base; 8 bps per side stress; 1% annual borrow prorated by holding minutes; hard order cap 1% ADV.
data_contract.missing_prices: A name missing a required 09:30 signal field or exact 09:40 entry is excluded before ranking/refill. Exit availability is not inspected during selection. If the scheduled 09:50/09:55 exit bar is absent, keep the exit order live and fill at the first available five-minute bar open through 16:00; no post-entry replacement is allowed. No same-session print is a hard failure.

development_gate.winner: Highest development Sharpe, then CAGR, among passing rows only.

validation_gate: The frozen development winner must have positive net and stress PnL, Sharpe >= 0.5, DD no worse than -12%, and positive PnL in both touched validation years.

audit_controls.full_refill: Signal and entry-price filtering occurs before each side is ranked and filled; future exit availability is excluded from refill decisions.
audit_controls.rule_selection_effect: Only the single preregistered development winner can enter validation; validation cannot select another row.
audit_controls.trade_selection_effect: PIT membership, beta, SIC residual, volume baseline, exact prices, side balance, SIC caps, ADV, costs, and compounding are rebuilt causally.
